articles.title: Landfill solar projects have taken off but still face practical limitations
articles.summary: The United States now has hundreds of solar installations on closed landfills. Increasing that number could prove tricky, however, as remaining sites may be limited by shifting federal policy, remediation costs and geography.

articles.title: House lawmakers press FERC on affordability, reliability and gas
articles.summary: Commissioners cited inadequate transmission infrastructure as a major concern. A gas-fired project in the PJM Interconnection needs $1 billion in grid upgrades to come online, said Commissioner David Rosner.

articles.title: TVA pursues 6.2 GW of new generation, citing data centers, population growth
articles.summary: Data center demand “climbed to 18% of our industrial load in 2025, and we are projecting data center growth to double in our region by 2030,” said CEO Don Moul.

articles.title: Denmark begins study on potential use of nuclear energy
articles.summary: A framework is now in place for investigating the "potential and risks" of new nuclear technologies - including small modular reactors - and the lifting of a moratorium on nuclear power, Denmark's Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities has announced.

articles.title: Kairos secures HALEU for Hermes' first fuel load
articles.summary: Kairos Power has finalised a contract with the US Department of Energy to receive the high-assay low-enriched uranium that will be used to make the fuel for the startup and operation of its Hermes low-power demonstration reactor.

articles.title: Drone test flights prove possibilities for use in fusion
articles.summary: A drone mounted with cameras and sensors has been used for the first time to inspect the Joint European Torus former fusion research facility at the UK Atomic Energy Authority's Culham Campus, in Oxfordshire, UK.

articles.title: Plans for two new reactors confirmed by South Korea
articles.summary: South Korea still plans to construct two new large nuclear power reactors by 2038, in line with its 11th Basic Plan for Electricity Supply and Demand, Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment Kim Sung-hwan has said.

articles.title: Argentina planning to reactivate heavy water plant
articles.summary: Argentina's National Atomic Energy Commission says it will carry out maintenance duties at the Neuquén Heavy Water Industrial Plant, and prepare a bidding process for the work necessary to restart production.

articles.title: UK-US partnership for HALEU transport packages
articles.summary: The UK's Nuclear Transport Solutions has signed a strategic agreement with Westinghouse of the USA to work together on the development of Pegasus – NTS's package designed for the safe transport of high-assay low-enriched uranium fuel.

articles.title: Oak Ridge at heart of US enrichment supply chain developments
articles.summary: BWX Technologies and Centrus Energy have marked major milestones as they build up their centrifuge manufacturing capacity in Tennessee, with BWXT opening a new facility and Centrus announcing major expansion plans, while laser enrichment technology LIS Technologies is also investing in Oak Ridge.

articles.title: Stellaria seeks permission to build experimental reactor
articles.summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has announced it is seeking the necessary authorisations to construct an experimental reactor. Its application is now under review.

articles.title: Zhangzhou 3's steam generators lifted into place
articles.summary: The third and final steam generator was moved into position at Zhangzhou nuclear power plant unit 3 on 26 January, the third of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in China's Fujian province.

articles.title: Indian government releases draft energy policy
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Power has released a draft energy strategy which aims to transform the country's power sector to meet the goals of the Viksit Bharat development strategy - and aligns with nuclear energy goals set out in the 2025-26 Budget and the recently enacted SHANTI bill.

articles.title: Mott MacDonald to advise UK government on Sizewell C
articles.summary: Global engineering, management and development consultancy Mott MacDonald has been awarded a contract by the UK's Department for Energy Security and Net Zero to deliver technical advisory services in support of government oversight of the Sizewell C nuclear power plant project.

articles.title: Steam generator removal begins at German plant
articles.summary: The removal of the first of four steam generators from the reactor building has begun at the shutdown Grafenrheinfeld nuclear power plant in Germany.

articles.title: Strategic agreements for US cobalt-60 supply chain
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company, Nordion (Canada) Inc, and PSEG Nuclear LLC have announced key milestones in their joint initiative to establish the first commercial-scale production of cobalt-60 in US pressurised water reactors.

articles.title: First concrete for Uzbekistan SMR 'well before December'
articles.summary: Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev have discussed progress on the project to build a nuclear power plant featuring both large and small reactors.

articles.title: Amentum awarded further UK contracts by EDF
articles.summary: USA-based engineering company Amentum has been awarded several new contracts by EDF, worth up to GBP540 million (USD743 million), expanding the critical solutions it provides for the UK's existing reactor fleet as well as for the construction of the new Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Prodigy completes R&D project for transportable nuclear power plants
articles.summary: Canada’s Prodigy Clean Energy says it has completed a two-year research and development project, which received CAD2.75 million (USD2 million) of government funding, to advance its Transportable Nuclear Power Plant technology.

articles.title: Saskatchewan to evaluate large nuclear reactor technologies
articles.summary: The Government of Saskatchewan and utility SaskPower have announced plans to formally evaluate large nuclear reactor technologies for use in the Canadian province. Saskatchewan already has plans for the deployment of small modular reactors.

articles.title: Russia targeting lunar power station by 2036
articles.summary: Roscosmos has signed a contract with NPO Lavochkin for the creation of a Russian lunar power station by 2036 - with an expectation it will necessitate three missions to the Moon, in 2033, 2034 and 2035.

articles.title: NextEra considering new nuclear capacity
articles.summary: US utility NextEra Energy said it could add up to 6 GWe of small modular reactor generating capacity at its existing nuclear power plant sites or potential new sites, primarily to meet demand from data centres.

articles.title: Westinghouse, Tetra Tech to collaborate on nuclear new-build projects
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company has signed a memorandum of understanding with Tetra Tech Canada, establishing a collaboration framework supporting the development and deployment of Westinghouse AP1000 and AP300 reactor projects in Ontario.
